commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.

64' Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) attempts to convert a cross into a goal, but his promising header from near the penalty spot towards the middle of the net is denied by Mory Diaw. This effort really didn't trouble him.
61' Great save! Junior Mwanga (Strasbourg) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the bottom left corner was brilliantly saved by Mory Diaw.
60' Matz Sels displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Elbasan Rashani (Clermont) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
